preconditions.description: Input integer n is within the range [1, 10^5].

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= i for i, x in enumerate(stdin.split()[1:], 1))
preconditions.description: For each a_i in the input array, 0 ≤ a_i ≤ i holds, where i is the 1-based index.

preconditions.expression: all(int(stdin.split()[i+1]) >= int(stdin.split()[i]) for i in range(len(stdin.split())-2))
preconditions.description: The input array a is non-decreasing, i.e., a_i ≤ a_{i+1} for all 1 ≤ i < n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: If no valid array b exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a space-separated list of integers b_i where each 0 ≤ b_i ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(MEX(set(stdout.split()[:i+1])) == int(stdin.split()[i+1]) for i in range(len(stdin.split())-1))
postconditions.description: For each prefix of b of length i+1 (1 ≤ i ≤ n), the MEX of the set {b_1, ..., b_i} equals a_i, where MEX(S) is the smallest non-negative integer not in S.
If a valid array b exists, its length is exactly n; otherwise, output is '-1'.
